meta.name: jobs-to-be-done
meta.description: Uncover customer jobs, pains, and gains in a structured JTBD format. Use when clarifying unmet needs, repositioning a product, or improving discovery and messaging.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别客户未满足的需求并优化产品定位
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要深入理解客户动机并改进产品策略。
copy.tagline_en: Identify unmet customer needs and refine product positioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deeply understand customer motivations and improve product strategy.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按步骤系统挖掘客户的任务（功能、社交、情感）、痛点（挑战、成本、错误、未解决项）和收益（期望、节省、采用因素、生活改善），并输出结构化表格。
howto.when: 当你需要澄清未满足的需求、重新定位产品、改进客户发现或营销信息时触发。也适用于早期发现、验证产品市场契合度、优先级排序、竞争分析。

say.text: 帮我分析一下我们的目标用户群体，找出他们的核心任务和痛点。
针对我们的新产品，用 JTBD 框架挖掘用户的社交和情感需求。
say.note: Claude 会重点探索社交和情感任务，并记录相关示例。

howto.what_en: Guides you through a structured JTBD process to uncover customer jobs (functional, social, emotional), pains (challenges, costs, mistakes, unresolved), and gains (expectations, savings, adoption factors, life improvement), outputting a structured table.
howto.when_en: Use when clarifying unmet needs, repositioning a product, improving discovery and messaging, or during early-stage discovery, product-market fit validation, roadmap prioritization, competitive analysis, and marketing messaging.

say_en.text: Help me analyze our target user segment and identify their core jobs and pains.
For our new product, use the JTBD framework to uncover social and emotional jobs.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on social and emotional jobs and record relevant examples.
